_about: T.O. 1C-131B-2-2 page 2B's plan view, drawn nose down on the page: the scan's crop 100,780,1680,1950 turned 90 degrees clockwise (nose left) and saved at 72 dpi, then layers.py --mode image --threshold 170 at scale 3 with --xscale 1.0525: the plan is drawn 5% short lengthwise against the side view and its own printed 79 ft 2 in (nose to tail cone 3231 px at scale 3 against the side's 3400.5), while across it is at the side's scale (its tips 32.14 m apart against the printed 105 ft 4 in; the fuselage 2.81 m wide against 9 ft 5 in). The propellers' plane lands on the side view's once evened out. Pixels of that raster, line centres; the upper half. The nacelle hides the wing's edges across it, and the 13 ft 6 in dimension's arrow crosses the leading edge by the root (both bridged), the tailplane's root the fuselage's side (bridged). The C-131B's nacelle isn't traced (derive.py).
